lines.text: Unit 02Spread of Islam
Sciences
A huge number of scientific works were translated into Arabic, mostly from Greek
language, during the Umayad period. Khalid Ibn Yazid brought some scholars from
works of Chemistry and medicine into Arabic. In Andalusia,the Muslims were at advanced
level of religious disciplines as well as other scholarly subjects. Literacy was very high in
Andalusia. According to various historical sources, there were four hundred thousand
books in the library of Cordoba. Great Masjid of Cordoba, Madinat uz Zahra Masjid and
Alhambra Palacearefew ofthewell-knownmonuments ofthatperiod.
AdministrationandEconomicSystem
Consolidation of the Muslim state was first task of Hazrat Mu'awiya .Political and
military affairs, tax collection, and religious administration were three main branches of
the administration of government.
Administration
The empire was divided into several provinces where governors were appointed to run
administration.Tax collection, religious affairs, law and order, and civil administration was
underthegovernors.
Economy
ngi
During the reign of Umayyad caliphs, due to expansion of
the borders, the trade size increased. Foreign trade
expanded and agriculture advanced significantly.Monetary
policies were renewed, and new methods of irrigation,
fertilization,and crop rotation were adopted. Umayyads
maintained the roads for trade and military movement.
Gold Dinar
Currency
Umayyad leaders continued using coin system of the
Byzantine and Sassanid Empires.Coins had phrases from
theQuranstamped on them.These werethe first coins in
history, minted by a Muslim government.Dinars were
made of gold while dirhams were made of silver.
Silver Dirham
HazratUmarBinAbdulAziz
He remained caliph from 717 to 720 AD.His caliphate wil be remembered as
revival of the spirit of pious caliphate.His governance was a symbol of equality and
public welfare.He appointed his governors based on their uprightness. He gave
greater importance to Qazis (judges) thus kept the flag of justice always high.
